correctness.rationale: The relation space of the six world points has dimension two. For any collinear image sextuple, two independent relation vectors give two independent left-kernel vectors of the focal matrix, hence matrix rank at most \(16\); the determinant and all first derivatives therefore vanish. Fresh exact symbolic reconstruction at \(p_i=[1:i:0]\) reproduced focal-matrix rank \(16\), zero gradient, Hessian rank \(4\), an \(8\)-dimensional collinearity tangent space contained in the Hessian kernel, and normal minor determinant \(484\). Equality of tangent space and Hessian kernel plus the implicit-function/Morse-Bott argument gives the stated local node and generic-open persistence.
